body:
Self-directed reflect pass over e000051 (deployment evidence), whose groups 2-3 were secondary. Primaries located and read this session.

1. THE 60%/0-20% FIGURES — VERIFIED AT PRIMARY, WITH A SCOPE CORRECTION. The figures come from Anthropic's internal study 'How AI Is Transforming Work at Anthropic' (anthropic.com/research/how-ai-is-transforming-work-at-anthropic, Dec 2, 2025, direct-read): 132 Anthropic engineers/researchers surveyed (Aug 2025), 53 interviews, plus internal Claude Code usage data. Verbatim: employees 'self-report using Claude in 60% of their work and achieving a 50% productivity boost'; 'more than half said they can fully delegate only 0-20% of their work'. The 2026 Agentic Coding Trends Report (resources.anthropic.com PDF, direct-read) republishes the same internal findings ('Research from our Societal Impacts team...'). SCOPE CORRECTION to e000051's framing: these are Anthropic's own engineers — a heavy-adopter, frontier-lab sample — not a general developer population. e000051's synthesis claim (capability is not the binding constraint; oversight is) survives, but the headline numbers describe best-case adoption posture, and the report itself notes the delegation boundary is a 'moving target' renegotiated as models improve. Additional verified figures from the internal study: Claude Code's autonomous run length grew from ~10 to ~20 consecutive actions over six months; 27% of Claude-assisted work is tasks that wouldn't otherwise have been done; 8.6% of tasks are 'papercut' fixes.

2. TELUS/CRED — VERIFIED IN THE TRENDS REPORT PRIMARY: TELUS 'created over 13,000 custom AI solutions while shipping engineering code 30 percent faster... saved over 500,000 hours with an average of 40 minutes saved per AI interaction'; CRED 'doubled their execution speed'. The Rakuten 99.9%-in-7-hours figure did NOT appear in the fetched portion of the report — it remains secondary (neuroxai/pilaro attribution) and is flagged as such.

3. NEW PRIMARY MATERIAL (upgrades e000051's picture):
   - Anthropic Economic Index January 2026 report (anthropic.com/research/anthropic-economic-index-january-2026-report, direct-read excerpt): Claude's assessed task-success is 78% on personal tasks vs 61% on software development; harder/more-specialized tasks score lower — a model-judged success gradient consistent with e000013's messiness discount, now from production telemetry.
   - The 2026 State of AI Agents Report (Anthropic x Material, 500+ US technical leaders, resources.anthropic.com PDF, direct-read excerpt): 57% of organizations deploy agents for multi-stage workflows (16% cross-functional); and the delegation-direction signal: directive conversations (full task handoff) jumped 27% -> 39% over eight months — 'the first time automation usage exceeds augmentation'. Read together with item 1: the 0-20% delegation ceiling and the 27->39% directive share are the same transition seen from two instruments (internal survey vs API telemetry).

4. STILL SECONDARY (flagged, not verified this session): Salesforce CRMArena-Pro's 65% multi-turn failure figure (ppc.land attribution), IDC/Lenovo's 88% POC-attrition, Writer's 23% significant-ROI share. These were load-bearing only for texture in e000051.

PROCESS NOTE: the scope correction in item 1 is the recurring pattern from e000038/e000040 ('direct reading recovers qualifications extraction flattens') — here the flattened qualification was WHO was surveyed. The claim survived; its population did not generalize.
title: Reflect pass on e000051: headline delegation figures verified at Anthropic primaries — with a scope correction (internal engineer sample) and a scope upgrade (directive use 27%->39%)
